name: browser-use
headline: antigravity-n8n-skills for workflow automation
short_description: Automate and validate n8n workflows with Google Antigravity skills. Ideal for operations teams to streamline node configuration and ensure flawless automation.
author: WilkoMarketing

sections.overview:
antigravity-n8n-skills is a collection of seven specialized skills that train Google Antigravity agents to build production-ready n8n workflows. The skills cover critical areas including n8n expression syntax (with patterns like `{{ $json.body }}`), effective use of n8n-mcp tools, proven workflow architectural patterns, validation error interpretation, operation-aware node configuration, and JavaScript and Python code node development. When activated by relevant questions about n8n configuration, expressions, or debugging, these skills guide agents through proper syntax, data access patterns, and workflow design best practices. Operations teams and automation engineers benefit from faster workflow development, fewer validation errors, and consistent adherence to n8n conventions without manual reference checking.
Writing correct n8n expressions to access webhook data and node variables
Configuring n8n nodes with operation-specific fields (e.g., Slack post vs. update)
Debugging workflow validation failures and interpreting error messages
Building webhook-triggered, HTTP API, database, AI agent, and scheduled workflows
- **Trigger**: New row in Google Sheets
- **Nodes**: Google Sheets, HTTP Request, Function, IF, Set, Merge, Webhook
